_comment: MSIX package identity, from Partner Center > Usage Monitor for Claude AI > Product management > Product identity (2026-10-26). name = Package/Identity/Name, publisher = Package/Identity/Publisher, publisher_display_name = Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName, display_name = the reserved app name (keep it equal to STORE_NAME in claude_usage/store.py - tests/store_mode.py checks it).
name: 30km.huKft.UsageMonitorforClaudeAI
description: Always-on-top panel that shows how much of your own Claude subscription is used: the 5-hour and weekly limits, per-model limits, reset times, pace and notifications. Free, open source, no telemetry. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC.
